strongest_angle: Josh Wander, co-founder of 777 Partners, pleaded guilty in Manhattan federal court to wire fraud and securities fraud in connection with a $500 million financial scheme.

key_facts.fact: Josh Wander, co-founder of Miami-based 777 Partners, pleaded guilty in Manhattan federal court to wire fraud and securities fraud involving at least $500 million in losses.
Federal prosecutors in the Southern District of New York charged Joshua Wander with orchestrating a scheme to bilk lenders and investors out of $500 million before the firm collapsed.
Josh Wander, aged 45, admitted to fraud in connection with the multi-layered financial scheme involving 777 Partners.
